label: Did the pipeline decide right?
explain: The pipeline already decided each row (accept / regenerate / hold). KEEP agrees; an OVERRIDE teaches the criteria ledger. A blank answer counts as nothing.
options: OVERRIDE: the art is fine, accept it
OVERRIDE: the art is bad, regenerate
REVERT: put my kept version back (rows that replaced your kept art)
